resources.string: Pair another phone, run your app and view its logs
Use the same Wi-Fi or hotspot. On the test phone (Android 11+), open Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code, and keep that dialog open.
Run this project on this device
Use “IP address & port” on the main Wireless debugging screen. This is different from the pairing port and may change.

On the test phone, choose “Pair device with pairing code”. Keep that dialog open, and enter its port and six-digit code here. After pairing, return to the main Wireless debugging screen for the connection port.
Enter the device IP address without a port or URL.
Paired, but the connection service was not found yet. Keep wireless debugging enabled, then try automatic connection, or enter its connection port under Advanced connection.
The test phone must run Android 11 or later.
Timed out. Check the network, wireless debugging, and the current device port.
Cancelled. The app may already have been installed on the test phone.
A remote operation is in progress.
Log streaming stopped. Reconnect or start reading logs again.
Set up the wireless debugging device before running this project.
Select a device below. Pairing connects automatically.
No devices found. Check the Wi-Fi / hotspot and enable wireless debugging on the test phone. For first-time pairing, keep its pairing-code dialog open. Advanced connection is also available.
Discovery is unavailable. Search again or use Advanced connection.
Finding the device’s current connection port…
Select a device below or use Advanced connection.
Enter the six-digit code shown on the test phone and keep that dialog open. The address and ports are found automatically.
This device does not match the selected device’s identity. Select the intended device again.
Select a nearby device to get started. First-time pairing needs only its six-digit code.
After building, install and start the app here. This setting applies to the current project.
If discovery is unavailable, enter the address shown on the test phone. Use the main Wireless debugging screen for the connection port.
